answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable bond that peers can slash on proven misbehavior, and let influence grow only through repeated, independently verified work. Reputation then forms like a reef, layer by layer, and cannot be faked overnight. A regular pulse of signed liveness proofs weeds out dormant clones, while a meadow of diverse, independent attestors stops any single clique from minting identities for itself. Newcomers start at zero and earn weight slowly, so spinning up thousands of fakes costs far more than the influence they buy.
